description: parseConfig(JSON.stringify(input)) followed by saveConfig(): `output` is the exact text written — JSON.stringify(config, null, 2) plus a trailing newline, keys in schema declaration order, defaults filled, unknown keys dropped, record entries (providers, agents.list, mcpServers, channels, extension settings) in the order the input gave them.

cases.name: an empty object fills every default
unknown keys are dropped at every level
a tilde workspace is written back verbatim
key order in the input does not survive; schema order does
provider instances keep their own key order
an agent entry with optional fields set and unset
an MCP server with an OAuth block
a channel block the schema does not name is kept as-is
extension settings are kept as-is
strings with unicode and escapes
